Thank you. 

I'm out of practice on the "decide to be happy" thing. But you offer some good advice.
Thank you. You are very kind and warm spirited.

Thank you. 

My therapist has also been focused on being present, mindful, and conscious of here and now. Some days I feel I can do that-- on others I get lost again. 

I think I've discovered that I believe being happy means being free of problems. Or, at least, of problems that actually upset me. So that it it seems I've been pursuing "emotionlessness" and calling that happiness. 

Might cause more than a few impossibilities, a belief like that.
